ZMB.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI is named only in health and mining sector systems.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Technology and Science, with the Finnish Government, has embarked on a pilot programme to integrate AI in the health and mining sectors, for health record-keeping and data analysis and for mineral stock data, Minister Felix Mutati says.
facts.system: Pilot programme to integrate AI in health and mining
